source_hash_policy: UTF-8 ts/mjs/json source canonicalized CRLF to LF for Git portability; ONNX/WASM binary hashes remain exact. Observed-byte hashes separately bind the actual execution files.
input_digest_encoding: ECMAScript JSON of [full contiguous history, first twelve reserved targets]

protocol.offsets: zero and two observed-prefix ranges multiplied by the same unit factor; no held-out target chooses the offset
protocol.original_history: Full contiguous reevaluation prefixes; never display-decimated trace arrays
protocol.observable_check: Point path must overlap [observed min-range, observed max+range]; interval endpoints may extend outside it
protocol.tolerance_basis: Binary64 classical arithmetic budget;128 binary32 epsilon for the actual normalized ONNX path. Errors are divided by observed prefix standard deviation, never an absolute U tolerance.
protocol.flat_path_advisory: Path spread at most1e-6 of observed range; valid SES/flat predictions are not blockers

scientific_boundary: This checks observable consistency and positive-affine transformation behavior, not forecast accuracy or ranking.
Held-out targets enter only the post-prediction loose observable-range diagnostic, never fitting or normalization.
Classical Gaussian intervals retain their residual-sigma times sqrt(lead) assumption; this audit does not establish its probabilistic validity.
ONNX intervals are per-lead marginal residual bands calibrated on a declared synthetic population; real-series unit consistency does not establish real-data coverage.

model_hash_rejection.fixture: One changed byte in an actual external ONNX file, served by private Vite; no intercepted requests or fabricated predictions
model_hash_rejection.reason: Browser model differs from its calibration
